content: Fitoror halas
He šomot badša Herude zulum goribolla zomator hoekzon manušore dori annil.
Hite Yuhannar bái Yakubore toluwar loi kun gori felaiye.
Henot Ihudi okkole kuši oiyede deki hite abar giye edde Fitorore o doijje. In goiṭṭede iš adiya ruṭir idor šomot.

Hite Fitorore dori ziyol golai raikke. Ar Fitorore fahara dibolla sairzon sairzon gori šoinno okkolor uwore bar diya oiye. Herude ṭik goijjede uddar idor bade bisar goribolla Fitorore mainšor hãse niyolai anibo.
Hetolla Fitorore ziyolot bondi raka oil. Zomator manuš okkole kintu hiballa Allar hãse ekmone duwa goijje.
Ze din Herude bisar goribolla Fitorore niyolai anibo, hiyar agor raitta duizon šoinnor maze Fitor gum zai aššil. Hibare duiyan siyol loi bandi raka oil, ar faharadar okkole dorozat fahara dil.

So, hen šomot atikka Allar ek firista heṛe aiyore tiyaiyegai. Henot ziyolhanagan fohore ujjol oigiyegoi. Firistaye Fitoror gat zure ṭela diyore gumottu tuli diye edde hodde: "Toratori uṭ!" Henot Fitoror dui hatottu siyol kuli fori giyegoi.
Hetunot firistaye hodde: "Tor kĩyailot kiyail bandoni band edde šendal find," Fitore hen goijje. Bade firistaye hodde: "Tor saddor gat diyore ãr fise fise ai."
Henot Fitore niyoliyore firistar fise fise za šuru goijje. Kintu firistar duwara zin gora oiye, hin ze hãsa hin hibaye buzi no faijjil, bolke hibaye šoppon deker buli mone goijje.

Bade hitara foila edde dusora faharadar okkolor dolore ḍiyai zaiyore šohorot golede luwar dorozar hãse aišše. Dorozagan hitaralla onegane kuli giyegoi, ar hitara heṛe butottu di niyoli giyegoi. Hitara ekkan rasta bai, rasta hiyan furafan foijjonto giye. Ar hetunot firistawa atikka hibar hãsottu gayeb oigiyegoi.
Hetunot Fitore buzi fariyore hodde, "Ehon ãi buzilam, Malik nize firista defeṛaiye edde Herudor hatottu edde Ihudi okkolor har monor issattu ãre uddar goijje."
Ei babute buzi fariyore hibaye Yuhannar ma Moriyamor górot giye. Ei Yuhannare Mark hoi o ḍaka oito. He górot boute ekku fũwati dola oi munazat goijje.
Fitore battu tai doroza bajjaiye toi Ruda name ekzon goroni maya fuwaye doroza kuli dibolla aišše.
Fitoror abaz sini fariyore hibaye eto kuši oiye, doroza no kulite, dũri butore giye edde hoiye, ze Fitor dorozar hãse tiyai roiye!
Hetunot biššaši okkole he mayafuwaware hodde, "Tor mata horaf oiyede oibo." Kintu hibaye bar bar zurgori zehon hoiye hitara hodde, "Toile iba Fitoror firista."
Eṛe Fitore doroza baijjat roiye. Hetunot biššaši okkole doroza kuli Fitorore deki ammuwak oiye.

Fitore hitarare nizam oibolla hate išara goijje edde ziyolottu Malike hibare kengori niyolai ainne hiyan zanaiye. Toi Fitore hodde, "Tũwara ei hóbor Yakubore edde aro báiyain okkolore hoiyo," hen hoi hiba hentu niyoli oinno zagat giyegoi.
Binna sore šoinno okkolor maze uruskul oiye, Fitor hoṛe giyegoi hoi.

Herude Fitorore talaš goijje, kintu hibare tuwai zehon no fa, faharadar okkolore zera goijje edde hite hitarare mari felaibolla hokum diye. Tarfore Herude Ehudiyattu Sizeriya giye edde heṛe hoto din taikke.
Herudor mout

Hešomot Herud Tiros edde Sidon šohoror manuš okkolor uwore guššaye oin oil. Ehon, heṛiyar manuš okkole ekkui fũwati miliyore Herud loi deha gorito gil. Blastos name ekzon badšar góror has hormosari loi hat goriyore hitara badšattu šanti saiye, kiyollahoile hitarar hánar zinišfati okkol he badšar dešottu itarar dešot aito.
Hẽtte ekdin Herude ekkan din ṭik goijje, hite hedin raz fušak findi šingašonot boiyore hitarare bašon diye.
Hitar hota funi manuš okkole guzoriyore hodde: "In oilde devotar abaz, manušor no!"
Hetunot atikka Mabudor ekzon firistaye hitare maijje, kiyollahoile hite Allare tarif no de. Hitar ga loge háiye edde morigiyegoi.
Kintu Allar kalam mummikka giye edde sairo mikka sorai gilgoi.
Ar Barnabas edde Saule Zeruzalemot hitarar šebar ham šeš gori bade, Yuhanna, zare Mark ho hibare fũwati loi hitara uwafes firi giyegoi.
